title: Let Naam swallow the smaller fears
summary: Naam absorbs the heart until the lesser fears no longer hold the room. Let the nectar of the Unspoken become larger than the alarm.
takeaway: Let Naam grow larger than the fears trying to govern you.
lifeApplication: When anxious fragments begin to multiply, sit with one remembered line until the fear has to share space with Naam.

source.shortMeaning: Speaking the Unspoken and being absorbed in Naam makes lesser fears fade from command.
source.lifeApplication: When smaller fears multiply, return to Naam until they lose authority over the room inside.

evidence.coreClaim: Speaking the Unspoken and being absorbed in Naam makes lesser fears fade from command.
evidence.turn: Let the tasted sweetness of Naam become larger than the fears trying to govern you.
evidence.practicalImplication: When anxious fragments begin to multiply, sit with one remembered line until the fear has to share space with Naam.
